about.description: A lightweight sandboxing tool for enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on arbitrary processes at the OS level, without requiring a container.
about.head: e025055

name: v0.0.78
body:
## What's Changed
* Make nine tests able to fail, and cover globToRegex and the public export list by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/570
* Correct five false statements, and remove dead and duplicated code by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/571
* test: fix the typecheck of the seccomp suite that broke main by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/583
* linux: exit status under zsh, and import zod/v3 by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/590
* Write limits are judged by where a write lands: say so, and test it by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/614
* linux: bind a deny path that another sandbox makes while the wrap is looking by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/618
* ci: pin workflow inputs, use npm trusted publishing, pack on pull requests by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/632


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/compare/v0.0.77...v0.0.78
